column4: Data are used for SDG 12.3.1 '(a) Food loss index and (b) food waste index'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 12.3.1.

The drop in overall recycling rate in 2020 was largely due to the substantially smaller amounts of Ferrous Metal scrap and Construction and Demolition waste generated and recycled.  While the recycling rates for these two waste streams did not change, a drop in the quantities of these waste streams affected the overall recycling rate as they make up a significant portion of the waste mix.  The lower recycling rate of paper/cardboard also contributed to the lower overall recycling rate because recyclables collection programmes by Public Waste Collectors were halted during the Circuit Breaker in Singapore (April to June 2020).
